notes.title: Demo Patch 0.2
notes.content: [h3][b]\[Patch Notes] Major Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Train Mode Added[/b]: You can now test your skills freely before entering battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Maps[/b]: New environments have been added for more diverse gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Round Clear Feedback Improved[/b]: Enhanced feedback and effects upon clearing a round.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camera Improvements[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Adjusted camera height for better visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced jitter issues occurring in specific situations.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Skill Visuals Enhanced[/b]: Improved visual clarity for level 2 and level 3 skills.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Visuals Improved[/b]: Enhanced UI elements for better readability and immersion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed Skill Effect Sound Bugs[/b]: Resolved an issue where some skill sounds wouldn’t play properly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character HP Bar Improved[/b]: Improved design and visibility of the health bar for clearer combat feedback.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound Improvements[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Added new footstep sounds for the character.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved dash sound for smoother audio feedback.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.1.1
notes.content: [list][*][p]Improved the tutorial experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new tutorial steps.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced the hit feedback effects for the player character.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the size of enemy projectiles.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the visual effect for the Darkness 5-synergy.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified the flow so that after winning a round, there is a brief pause before proceeding to the next round.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced jittering issues.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.1
notes.content: [h3][b]\[Notice][/b][/h3][p]We are currently improving the patching system. As a result, patch sizes may be temporarily larger than usual.[/p][hr][/hr][h3] [b]\[New Features][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added multilingual support for tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced a new tutorial to enhance player understanding of the game.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3] [b]\[UI & Font Improvements][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Updated the in-game font used across the UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Skill effects now become more transparent when multiple skills are activated simultaneously.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3] [b]\[Bug Fixes][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the electric attribute's stagger effect was not working properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where an excessive number of "0" damage texts appeared when the 5-stack synergy of the electric attribute was triggered.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented key settings from being changed after returning from the lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]Mitigated an issue where some skill sounds failed to play when multiple sounds were triggered at once.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3] [b]\[Balance & System Changes][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Buffed the special effect of the darkness attribute.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the basic attack feature.[/p][/*][*][p]Reorganized the default key settings for skills.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.2
notes.content: [p][b]\[Balance Adjustments][/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced the number of summoned bosses, while slightly increasing their individual combat strength.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[UI Improvements][/b][/p][list][*][p]Added visual feedback elements to the main lobby and stage UI to enhance clarity and user experience.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Other Improvements][/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved overall game stability to reduce unexpected crashes in certain environments.[/p][/*][/list]
